svg.title: Two rankings, one list
svg.text: Day 08: hybrid search, measured on Day 07's 81 labelled queries.
“Will Acme pay for wine with a business dinner?”
#6 and #4: both fairly high. Agreement lifts it to #3: 1/66 + 1/64.
RRF: no weight to tune, but 10 lookups lose first place
weighted: min-max scores, 0.7 dense + 0.3 BM25, weight chosen on dev
